name: zapier-explore
title_zh: 先问清你天天用哪五个应用
tagline_zh: 别再说「Zapier 能干嘛」了——它先盘你的岗位和常用应用，把用例变成可点的提示词，再一步步带你开通对应动作。
tagline_en: Stop asking what Zapier can do. It interviews your role and daily apps, turns use cases into tap-ready prompts.
desc_en: Explore what Zapier MCP can do for the user — interview them about their role and the apps they live in, suggest specific use cases as on-demand prompts, then walk them through enabling the actions to make those use cases real. The natural next step after `zapier-demo`. Use when the user asks "what else can Zapier do for me", "set up more tools", "add a starter pack for my role", "what should I en
why_zh: 不是罗列几百个 trigger/action 让你自己挑，而是先做需求访谈。
why_en: Skips the 300-action catalog dump. It interviews your actual workflow first, then translates it into minimal viable Zaps.
limit_zh: 只负责探索和引导开通动作，不替你创建或调试 Zap。需要你已有 Zapier 账号且目标应用已连接。
limit_en: Explores and guides enabling actions only — no Zap creation or debugging. Requires an existing Zapier account with connected apps; stops and asks if.
title_en: Interviews your stack first, then maps Zapier actions to it
